description.content: Retrieves the list of traffic forwarding rules. To learn more, see About Traffic Forwarding.
The search string used to match against the rule name.
The search string used to match against the rule order.
The search string used to match against the rule description.
The search string used to match against the rule forwarding method. Supported forwarding methods are ZIA, ZPA, DIRECT, and DROP.
The search string used to match against the locations or sublocations used in rule configurations.
Specifies the page offset.
Specifies the page size. The default size is 50.
Rule parameter by which the list must be sorted.
Specifies whether the list must be sorted by ascending or descending rule order or by rule execution order.
